name: Blank Apparel (Wholesale)
tagline: A working wholesale storefront for a blank-apparel supplier.
description: A complete, working wholesale shop for a blank-apparel supplier: a real catalogue of blank tees, fleece, headwear and bags sold by the case and priced per unit, with Color × Size variant grids, categories, collections, a bespoke trade PDP carrying bulk price breaks and net-terms, and a merchandised home page pitched at decorators. Clean, catalogue-efficient theme — cool slate paper, near-black ink, one confident cobalt accent. Shipped as Blankstock.
